findings.desc: DONE-required timeout classification is not implemented across the promised layers. `runDoneRequiredValidation` records a command timeout as a FAIL receipt, but `handlers/done-required-validation.ts` maps every non-PASS to result=failed and always emits timeoutLayer=null; `done_prepare` then parses that as failed and omits timeoutLayer. The CLI idle/max watchdog in `cli-engine.ts` still calls process.exit(2), so direct/done_prepare JSON receives no terminal result at all for idle/max expiry. Even successful done_prepare reused/executed output omits timeoutLayer=null because `donePrepareJsonResult` only adds a recognized non-null token. This contradicts CHK-001/003 requirements for result=timed_out and timeoutLayer=command|phase|idle|max, and leaves the JSON contract unable to distinguish timeout from validation failure.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: real subprocess matrices force command, phase, CLI idle, and CLI max expiry and inspect JSON plus shell status. Root cause: command receipts collapsed timeout into generic failure, done_prepare omitted routine watchdog attribution, and cli-engine force-exited before handlers could settle. Fix: timeout receipts now map to result=timed_out/timeoutLayer=command; AbortController-backed structured watchdogs propagate idle|max to direct validation and done_prepare; phase remains phase-attributed; structured failed/timed_out/blocked output stays parseable and exits nonzero. ReproTest: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-progress-heartbeat-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.js. Both smoke commands PASS at HEAD a6cefb0 and assert nonzero timeout status plus immediate rerun cleanup.

findings.desc: The trusted metadata-only reuse lineage checks only the net tree diff (`git diff --name-only evidenceHead..currentHead`), not paths touched by every intervening commit. A descendant history can modify a code/config path and later restore it; that path disappears from the net diff, so this function can classify the lineage as trusted-story-metadata-descendant. This violates the documented and CHK-002 requirement that every intervening changed path be trusted metadata and that any intervening code/config path refuse reuse. Enumerate changed paths per commit across the ancestry range (including deletes/renames) or explicitly narrow the contract to final-tree equivalence.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: create evidence at an ancestor, modify a non-metadata path in one intervening commit, restore it in a later commit, then evaluate reuse; the former net diff hid the touched path. Root cause: lineage trust used only git diff evidenceHead..currentHead instead of enumerating paths touched by every commit. Fix: reuse now verifies ancestry, enumerates rev-list commits, reads each commit with diff-tree --no-renames, rejects any untrusted touched path including modify-then-revert and rename history, and rechecks HEAD to close TOCTOU. ReproTest: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs. Both PASS at HEAD a6cefb0 and mechanically cover per-commit lineage, non-ancestor, code/config paths, modify-revert, rename, and concurrent HEAD movement.

findings.desc: All 28 must intents are marked covered by four smoke commands, but the assertions exercise only a small subset. Budget tests use one 1,200,000ms command: no 290,000+1,200,000 sequence, default-timeout command, malformed/non-positive inputs, unrelated CLI max, LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS, or phase/max race; phase-timeout JSON does not assert disposition/result/refusalReasons/timeoutLayer. Reuse tests call the evaluator only and never exercise done_prepare default reuse, reuseFreshDoneRequired=false, fresh/stale/missing validate=false immutability, structured failure/timeout/block outputs, malformed/unreadable evidence, full lineage matrix, or TOCTOU. Direct-handler tests run an instant child and synchronous throwing sink only: no silent heartbeat past idle, real direct CLI watchdog, explicit idle/max, passing and failing rejected sinks, boundary ordering, descendant cleanup, lock reacquisition, or late-heartbeat race. Add table-driven budget tests and hermetic real-CLI fixtures per omitted intent, then bind each evidence ref to assertions that actually exist.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: compare all 28 must intent descriptions with their former smoke assertions; budget, reuse, malformed evidence, real CLI watchdog, process-tree cleanup, and sink rejection paths were absent. Root cause: broad command-level evidence was recorded without assertion-specific coverage. Fix: added table-driven arithmetic and override tests, real runValidationCommand overflow/fallback tests, actual done_prepare reuse/validate=false matrices, malformed evidence recovery, per-commit lineage and TOCTOU tests, real direct command/idle/max and routine done_prepare idle/max subprocesses, descendant kill plus immediate rerun, and sync/async progress-sink containment. findings.desc: Malformed or unreadable existing done-required evidence aborts the recovery path instead of being classified stale and replaced. evaluateDoneRequiredPreRunReuse calls evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence without a containment boundary (done-prepare-validation-reuse.ts:97), while StoryStore deliberately rethrows JSON parse/read errors for this artifact (store.ts:236-241). Both direct done_required_validate (done-required-validation.ts:46) and done_prepare validate=false/validate=true invoke that evaluator before they can execute or report structured status. A truncated JSON file therefore throws out of the command; even a valid JSON object with missing arrays can trigger TypeErrors in the canonical evaluator. This violates the fail-closed-but-convergent contract: malformed evidence must yield existingEvidenceBasis=stale with a refusal reason, validate=false must remain observation-only, and validate=true/direct validation must be able to run once and overwrite bad evidence. Catch artifact/evaluator shape/read failures in the pre-run reuse wrapper, return reusable=false/stale with a stable malformed-or-unreadable reason, and ensure execution does not depend on parsing prior evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: replace done-required-evidence.json with truncated JSON and then with a valid object missing required arrays; invoke validate=false observation and validate=true/direct execution. Root cause: evaluateDoneRequiredPreRunReuse allowed store read/parse and canonical evaluator shape exceptions to escape before execution. Fix: the reuse wrapper contains unreadable/malformed artifact and evaluator failures, returns reusable=false with existingEvidenceBasis=stale and stable evidence-malformed-or-unreadable refusal, while validate=false remains non-mutating and validate=true/direct validation overwrite bad evidence with a fresh receipt. ReproTest: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.js. Both PASS at HEAD a6cefb0 and assert malformed JSON/shape classification, byte-for-byte validate=false immutability, and successful recovery execution.

findings.desc: F-001 remains incomplete for done_prepare CLI idle/max timeouts. cli-engine now aborts a signal instead of exiting, but done_prepare only threads that parent signal into routine verifier.validate and the DONE-required runCloseoutPhase. The later doneClosure/reviewAssurance/runtimeChange/cleanTree/produceCommand runCloseoutPhase calls do not receive rawArgs.abortSignal, so an explicit max expiry during those phases is logged but does not terminate or structure the result. Even inside DONE-required validation, a parent CliWatchdogTimeoutError is not a DonePreparePhaseTimeoutError, so the catch falls through to `result=blocked` without timeoutLayer instead of `result=timed_out` with idle|max. The watchdog also has no top-level Promise.race fallback, so any uncooperative/synchronous done_prepare segment can outlive the absolute max. Thread/race the CLI watchdog across the whole handler and classify its reason before the generic blocked path; verify nonzero JSON outcomes for idle and max in both routine and post-validation closeout phases.
findings.resolvedReason: Source correction: the reviewer subclaim that later doneClosure/reviewAssurance/runtimeChange/cleanTree/produceCommand calls lacked the parent signal was disproven; every current call already passed rawArgs.abortSignal before this fix, so no false repro or worker redesign was used. Verified gaps: a parent CliWatchdogTimeoutError inside DONE-required closeout fell through generic blocked classification; closeout segments lacked explicit parent deadline checkpoints; and Promise.race could return before cooperative child/lock cleanup settled. Fix: all closeout segments now receive the full parent timeout control, check signal/deadline before and after work, classify parent idle|max as executed/timed_out at the active phase, abort cooperatively and await task/child settlement, while bounded sync-child wrappers enforce the first safe boundary. ReproTest: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-progress-heartbeat-smoke.js. PASS at REVIEW HEAD 2d5b5a6; real JSON/nonzero tests cover DONE-required phase plus post-validation closeout idle|max, descendant cleanup where a child exists, and immediate rerun.

findings.desc: The additive done_prepare JSON defaults misclassify any transcript that blocks before validation. `donePrepareJsonResult` now fills missing fields with disposition=skipped_explicitly, result=blocked/not_run, existingEvidenceBasis=missing, but `skipped_explicitly` is contractually reserved for validate=false. A merge/preflight/stale-evidence blocker did not explicitly skip validation and its existing evidence basis was never evaluated, so the emitted structure asserts false facts. Preserve nullable/not_applicable fields for pre-validation blockers, or evaluate and emit a distinct disposition that does not claim an explicit operator skip.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: request done_prepare --json for a nonexistent/unreadable story so preflight blocks before validation; prior additive defaults incorrectly emitted disposition=skipped_explicitly and existingEvidenceBasis=missing despite neither fact being observed. Root cause: donePrepareJsonResult synthesized validation fields whenever transcript tokens were absent. Fix: disposition, result, existingEvidenceBasis, timeoutLayer, and refusalReasons are emitted only when explicitly present in the transcript; explicit timeoutLayer=null remains distinguishable. validate=false, reuse, and execution paths retain their exact observed fields. ReproTest: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.js. PASS at REVIEW HEAD 2d5b5a6; preflight JSON exits nonzero, remains parseable, reports blockedAt=preflight, and omits all five unobserved validation fields.

findings.desc: Round-2 smokes pass, but the 28 must refs are still not assertion-specific and several safety cases remain unproved. The CHK-002 evidence map is shifted: happy:1 points to reuse-disabled execution (the edge:0 requirement), edge:0 points to validate=false (edge:1), edge:1 to canonical mutations (adversarial:0), edge:2 to lineage, edge:3 to malformed evidence, and adversarial:2 to generic output fields. More importantly, done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.ts:326-345 does not exercise actual exact-HEAD versus trusted-descendant reuse separately; reuse disabled only asserts a progress line, not disposition=executed or evidence refresh. done-required-validation-smoke.ts:429-655 lacks independent evidence-schema mutation, proof-admissibility failure mutation, non-ancestor HEAD, and metadata-like-outside-allowlist cases required by CHK-002 adversarial:0/2. The timeout matrices at validate-progress-heartbeat-smoke.ts:277-399 use wide timing margins rather than just-before/just-after command/phase/idle/max races; descendant ESRCH is asserted only for command timeout, while CHK-003 adversarial:0 requires descendant-tree termination separately for command, phase, idle, and max. No test emits heartbeat concurrently with abort/exit/error or asserts no post-terminal heartbeat/duplicate evidence. Add the missing matrix rows/race instrumentation, assert disabled-reuse terminal fields and refreshed receipt, and remap each verificationEvidence intentRef to its actual assertion before accepting coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: audit each of 28 must intent refs against its actual assertion; CHK-002 mappings were shifted and exact/descendant actual reuse, disabled receipt refresh, independent schema/proof/nonancestor/outside-allowlist, deterministic boundary seams, multi-layer descendant cleanup, and concurrent terminal ordering were missing. Root cause: command-level PASS evidence was mapped by theme rather than assertion identity. Fix: added separate actual done_prepare exact-head and trusted-descendant reuse, disabled-reuse executed/refreshed receipt assertions, independent schema/proof-admissibility/nonancestor/outside-allowlist rows, deterministic future/expired deadline seams, command-start concurrent abort ordering with no late heartbeat/duplicate evidence, and real command/phase/idle/max descendant ESRCH plus immediate rerun where children exist. Pure in-process closeout phases spawn no child and are precisely documented/evidenced as not applicable rather than fake ESRCH. All PASS at REVIEW HEAD 2d5b5a6; complete evidence is correctly remapped 9/9, 10/10, 9/9.

findings.desc: Post-validation closeout watchdog blocks overwrite already-observed validation facts. `cliWatchdogTimeoutBlock` always emits `disposition=executed` and `existingEvidenceBasis=stale`, even when done_prepare ran with validate=false and had already recorded `disposition=skipped_explicitly` plus a computed missing/fresh/stale basis. The new post-validation timeout smoke uses exactly validate=false/dryRun but asserts the fabricated executed disposition, locking in the contradiction. Keep overall `result=timed_out`/timeoutLayer=idle|max, but carry the validation disposition and evidence basis observed at the validate step (or separate validation outcome from overall command outcome). This is distinct from the fixed preflight case: here the fields were observed and are then replaced with false values.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: run validate=false to observe disposition=skipped_explicitly/result=not_run with the actual existingEvidenceBasis/refusalReasons, then force a later doneClosure idle or max timeout. The prior timeout block overwrote that context with fabricated disposition=executed and basis=stale. Root cause: cliWatchdogTimeoutBlock constructed a fresh generic validation terminal instead of carrying the already-observed validate step context. Fix: parse the completed validate step into an ObservedValidationTerminalContext; later closeout watchdog blocks preserve disposition, evidence basis, and refusals, append the real CLI timeout refusal, and change only result/timeoutLayer to timed_out/idle|max. ReproTest: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.js. PASS at REVIEW HEAD 7ffa19b; baseline-vs-timeout assertions cover idle and max, singular JSON, nonzero status, no story-evidence mutation, and immediate rerun.

findings.desc: Round-3 cleanup/race/lineage matrices pass, but the core top-level budget regression still lacks an assertion that can detect omitted closeout phases. In done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.ts:90-100 the fixture selects DONE-required phase=1,500,000ms and global phase=1,400,000ms, yet only asserts total >= 1,500,000 + 330,000. An implementation summing routine validation plus DONE-required while omitting all five other enabled closeout phases would still pass, contrary to CHK-001:edge:4. CHK-001:edge:3 also claims both DONE entry paths use derived command-specific maxima, but tests only assert story_get stays 900,000ms; there is no exact commandCliMaxBudget assertion for done_required_validate or done_prepare. Add exact expected totals for validate=true required-policy, validate=false, no-policy, global override, and phase-specific override combinations, plus exact derived maxima for both DONE entry paths. Also correct CHK-002:happy:0 evidence wording or add an actual exact-HEAD done_prepare fixture: seedDoneRequiredViaCli auto-commits evidence, so the current integration run proves trusted-metadata-descendant reuse, while exact-head is only covered at the evaluator unit level.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: inspect commandCliMaxBudget totals under required/no-policy and validate true/false; prior tests only asserted a lower bound, so omission or double-counting of a closeout phase could pass. Root cause: evidence described broad budget coverage without exact arithmetic for every enabled phase and the CHK-002 reuse notes conflated evaluator exact-HEAD with CLI metadata auto-commit lineage. Fix: exact totals now use six unique phase overrides plus a global override and assert routine sequential budget plus each enabled phase exactly once: five common closeout phases always, DONE-required only when required+validate, routine only when validate. Evidence correction: CHK-002 happy:0 now points to the evaluator exact-HEAD assertion; happy:1 points to actual done_prepare CLI integration, whose evidence auto-commit correctly proves trusted-story-metadata-descendant rather than exact HEAD. ReproTest: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js. PASS at REVIEW HEAD 7ffa19b; any omission of the five common phases changes exact totals and fails.

findings.desc: Routine done_prepare can still misclassify an explicit CLI max deadline as an ordinary validation failure. cli-engine passes both deadlineAt and an AbortSignal, but the validation runner independently shortens its command timer to deadlineAt (validation-executor.ts:309-314). If that timer settles before the polling watchdog aborts the signal—which is deterministic for MAX values not aligned with the watchdog interval, e.g. 1005ms with a 251ms poll—the verifier returns a failed/timed-out routine result while abortSignal.reason is still empty. done-prepare.ts:1651 only derives routineTimeoutLayer from the signal, then lines 1657-1663 take the generic parsed failure path, omitting disposition=executed, result=timed_out, timeoutLayer=max and existingEvidenceBasis. The new max smoke uses 180ms with a 45ms interval, aligning poll and deadline and masking this window. Treat Date.now() >= rawArgs.deadlineAt as max using rawArgs.deadlineError even before the signal fires, or propagate a named max-deadline reason through executeValidationPlan; add a deliberately non-divisible max fixture proving JSON classification and exit/event behavior.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: configure a silent routine validate command longer than LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS=1005 while the CLI watchdog polls every floor(1005/4)=251ms. The command deadline could settle between watchdog ticks before abortSignal carried a named reason, so routine validation returned generic failure instead of timed_out/max. Root cause: cli-engine created deadlineError but done_prepare/verifier/ExecuteValidationPlan propagated only deadlineAt; the runner therefore lost the controlling deadline source. Fix: deadlineError now flows cli-engine -> done_prepare -> verifier -> ExecuteValidationPlan -> command options; after child cleanup, a deadline-owned timedOut result throws the named max error for structured classification. ReproTest: node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-progress-heartbeat-smoke.js. PASS at REVIEW HEAD 7ffa19b; the 1005/251 real CLI regression asserts status=blocked, result=timed_out, timeoutLayer=max, existingEvidenceBasis=stale, exit 1, no generic validation-failed reason, and immediate successful rerun cleanup.

findings.desc: A remaining no-invented-fields gap exists for `validate=true,dryRun=true`. That branch records only `planned mutation skipped: dryRun does not run lattice validate`, so `observedValidationTerminalContext` correctly returns undefined. If a later closeout phase hits idle/max, `cliWatchdogTimeoutBlock` nevertheless falls back to disposition=executed and existingEvidenceBasis=stale, even though validation did not execute and the evidence basis was never evaluated. This is the same false-fact class F-006 prohibited, now reachable after the validate step. When validationContext is absent, emit only the observed overall timeout fields (result/refusalReasons/timeoutLayer) and omit disposition/basis, or explicitly record a truthful dry-run validation context before closeout.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: run done_prepare --validate=true --dryRun=true --json, force a later doneClosure idle timeout, and inspect the terminal JSON. Because dryRun skips actual validation, there is no observed validation terminal context; the old path nevertheless emitted disposition=executed, existingEvidenceBasis=stale, and a synthetic refusalReasons entry. Root cause: cliWatchdogTimeoutBlock used fallback executed/stale values and always constructed refusalReasons when validationContext was undefined. Fix: the watchdog now conditionally composes terminal context—when observed validationContext exists it preserves disposition/evidence basis/refusals and appends the real watchdog refusal; when none exists it emits only the true result=timed_out and timeoutLayer=idle|max plus the ordinary blocked reason. ReproTest: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs. PASS at REVIEW HEAD 2155e94; validate=true+dryRun JSON exits nonzero, reports blockedAt=doneClosure/result=timed_out/timeoutLayer=idle, emits one parseable object, and asserts disposition/existingEvidenceBasis/refusalReasons are absent, while existing validate=false idle|max cases retain observed context. Additional independent focused verification found no separate finding ID but exposed a sync-child cleanup gap: phase-bounded execFileSync/execSync used default SIGTERM and a resistant child reproduced 5041ms. Commit 47eb092 switches only phase-controlled deadlines to SIGKILL; the closure smoke now uses a SIGTERM-resistant child, verifies phase-bounded return plus immediate reap/restore, and passed three consecutive runs.

findings.desc: The new dryRun and SIGTERM-resistant sync regressions pass (including three consecutive closure-smoke runs), but refreshing evidence replaced rather than supplemented three broader must bindings, so the 28-ref map now overclaims coverage. CHK-003:adversarial:0 now runs only done-prepare-closure-heartbeat three times and its note covers SIGKILL/reap for phase-bounded execFileSync/execSync; it no longer binds validate-progress-heartbeat, which contains the command/CLI-idle/CLI-max spawned-descendant ESRCH and immediate-retry assertions required by that intent. CHK-003:edge:1 now cites only the validate=true dryRun closeout-idle case and no longer binds the direct done_required_validate formatter/noisy/silent/single-result coverage. CHK-002:edge:2 similarly replaced the broader executed pass/fail/command/phase/idle/max/policy/skip vocabulary evidence with one dryRun closeout timeout. Preserve the new focused evidence but use combined commands/notes (or multiple evidence rows per intent) so each must ref still names every required assertion; for adversarial:0 include validate-progress-heartbeat plus the triple closure smoke, not the triple closure smoke alone.
